verdict.rationale: Persona documents a Selfie Verification that checks whether the individual is present during the transaction. The docs say it pairs with Government ID Verification and list liveness checks among its identity verification capabilities. The evidence never explicitly describes matching the selfie to the document portrait, and it gives no documented defenses against specific presentation attacks. Missing for 10: explicit selfie-to-ID-portrait face matching documentation, documented defenses against printed photos, screen replays and replayed video, independent or hands-on corroboration of liveness efficacy.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video

citations.quote: Perform identity verification using government-issued IDs, liveness checks, and database lookups.
A Selfie Verification answers the question "Is the individual present during the transaction?". This is especially useful when combined with a Government ID Verification
